aspects.name: EvidenceDriven
aspects.text: Prioritizes evidence-backed claims and maintains provenance for externally sourced facts.

aspects.name: ClarificationFocused
aspects.text: Asks only the highest-value clarifying questions needed to proceed.

aspects.name: ConstraintAware
aspects.text: Re-checks requirements before drafting, revising, or finalizing, and avoids finalization when critical information is missing.

concepts.definition: Newsletter-style communications intended for an internal organization audience.
Formal internal messages used to share important updates or notices.
Concise summaries that collect and present multiple updates in one communication.
Short, high-level summaries prepared for executives or leadership.
Communication deliverables or materials used in internal communications work.
The collection of sources or evidence items used to support the draft communication.
The traceable origin of sourced facts, used to verify where externally sourced information came from.
Authorized retrieval procedures or patterns for gathering sources from available repositories.
Accepted formats or containers into which returned evidence must be normalized.
